paks.name: Boombrick
paks.description:
Your music, Spotify and YouTube Music in one player for the TrimUI Brick, with album art, synced lyrics and music that keeps playing while you game.

Features:
- Your music: MP3, FLAC, Opus and M4A (AAC) from the SD card, gapless, with ReplayGain levelling
- Browse by album, artist, song or genre; the queue has shuffle and repeat and is kept between launches
- Covers from the files, folder pictures or the Cover Art Archive, with the screen's colours taken from the album playing
- Synced lyrics from the files, .lrc files or LRCLIB, with the line being sung highlighted
- YouTube Music: search, browse albums and artists, and download songs as tagged Opus files with covers and lyrics; a song still downloading plays as soon as it lands
- Spotify (Premium): sign in with a code on your phone, then play Liked Songs and your playlists at 96, 160 or 320 kbps
- Spotify import: download your playlists' songs, or a single song, from YouTube Music to keep them offline, matched by ISRC or by title, artist and length
- Internet radio: browse and search stations from Radio Browser, save your favourites, and see the song a station is playing
- Play in background from the quick menu: the music goes on while you play a game
- Sleep timer: 15 to 60 minutes, or the end of the track or album, with a fade
- Screen off with Power, with skipping and pausing still working
- Titles and lyrics in every main script, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Thai and Hindi among them, and emoji; each script's font is downloaded the first time it's needed
- Switch Spotify, YouTube or Radio off in Settings if you don't use them
- Updates for Boombrick and its downloader from Settings

Wi-Fi is used for Spotify, YouTube Music, radio, covers, lyrics, fonts and updates; the music on the card plays without it. Your library and settings are kept in .userdata/tg5040/Boombrick and downloads in Music/Boombrick, so updates never touch them.

paks.name: ReminisLink
paks.description: Manage the ROMs, saves, save states, cheats and patches of your handheld from your iPhone, iPad or Mac, over your local Wi-Fi. Bring your own files. Tested on the TrimUI Brick; experimental on the TrimUI Smart Pro S, Anbernic H700 handhelds and Miyoo Flip (testers welcome).

changelog.v1.0.0:
First release:
- Pair your iPhone with a QR code (no PIN). The connection is encrypted (HTTPS, pinned to the public-key fingerprint in the QR code); every request except the presence check and the pairing itself is signed. Several devices can be paired; your Apple devices share the pairing through iCloud Keychain.
- Pairings made with earlier test builds are deleted at the first launch: pair again by scanning the QR code (Settings > Pair a New Device).
- From the ReminisLink app: browse every game on the SD card, send games and box art, download any file of a game, back up and restore saves, lock save states, edit cheats and apply IPS, BPS and UPS patches.
- Manage the tools and emulators installed on the handheld (install from a zip, replace, remove) and browse the SD card (read only).
- The app updates live when the SD card changes and goes back to its list when you close ReminisLink.
- Nothing is deleted without a copy: deleted and replaced files go to a trash, purged at launch after 30 days of counted age.
- The handheld never connects to the internet.
- Interface in English and French.
changelog.v1.0.1:
Maintenance release:
- Updated libraries (DNS for Bonjour, image) with their security fixes; the handheld behaves the same.
- The clock file of a save (.rtc) is documented and tested with every save operation: backed up and restored with the save, kept when a save is replaced, and moved to the trash when the game is deleted.
changelog.v1.0.2:
Fixes and small improvements:
- Installing from the Pak Store works: the release zip now holds the pak at its root (it was nested one folder too deep and did not start). Installing by hand: unzip, then copy the ReminisLink.pak folder into Tools/tg5040.
- French interface: a non-breaking space before colons, question marks and percent signs, as French typography wants.
- The presence check documents the oldest app this pak supports, so the app can say whether the app or ReminisLink on the handheld needs an update.
changelog.v1.1.0:
New:
- Screenshots: the app lists the screenshots taken on the handheld (NextUI: the Screenshots folder; Knulli: /userdata/screenshots), with a preview of each, downloads them and moves them to the trash, from where they can be restored.
- Restore from the trash: from the app, a deleted game comes back with its save, clock file, save states, cheats and box art, and a deleted or replaced file or app comes back too. A file already on the SD card is never replaced (the app offers a free name instead), except a replaced save, which can take the place of the current save once that one is kept (in the trash, or as a backup copy); a restored app goes through the same checks as an installation.
- Files of the SD card: from the app, add files to a folder, create folders and move files or folders to the trash (restorable). Nothing is ever replaced; the folders the system needs (NextUI: the hidden folders at the root of the card; Knulli: /userdata/system), the main folders and ReminisLink itself are protected.
- Rename a game from the app: the game file and everything named after it (save, clock file, save states and their thumbnails, cheats, box art, backups and locks) in one step that a power cut cannot leave half done; a name already taken is refused.
- The game sheet gives the number of cheats.
- Shortcuts made by the Shortcuts pak no longer show up in the library: a tool shortcut is not a system, and a game shortcut is neither a game nor a system (the original game stays listed).
New handhelds (experimental):
- Experimental and looking for testers: TrimUI Smart Pro S (tg5050), Anbernic H700 handhelds (h700) and Miyoo Flip (my355) with NextUI. Not tested on these devices yet: please report how it goes.
- Knulli (experimental, looking for testers too): ReminisLink.knulli.zip is attached to the release, next to ReminisLink.pak.zip; unzip it into /userdata/roms/tools/.
